facts.text: Novi is a city in Oakland County that was organized as a township in 1832 and incorporated as a city in 1969.
Novi has direct access to I-96, I-696, I-275 and M-5.
Twelve Oaks Mall was built in Novi in 1977, and much of the city's retail is clustered around the Novi Road and I-96 interchange.
Novi has car dealerships along Haggerty Road and Grand River Avenue.
Walled Lake lies mainly within Novi, is the largest lake in the city, and is the headwaters of the Middle Branch of the Rouge River.
Lakeshore Park on South Lake Drive, the largest of the city's parks, has a summer swimming beach on Walled Lake along with mountain bike and walking trails.
Pavilion Shore Park, which opened in 2013 on the southern shore of Walled Lake, is the former home of the Walled Lake Amusement Park and the Walled Lake Casino.
Most of the farmland and open space Novi had in the mid-20th century has since been developed, with Tollgate Farm at Twelve Mile and Meadowbrook roads a notable exception.

The City of Novi's free Light the Lights holiday event, with fireworks, a tree lighting and visits with Santa, is held each November at Twelve Mile Crossing at Fountain Walk; the 2026 event is set for Friday, November 20.

christmas-light-installation.title: Christmas Light Installation in Novi, MI
christmas-light-installation.meta_description: Novi, MI Christmas light installation for subdivision homes and Walled Lake houses, with HOA-friendly designs, in-season service and takedown.
christmas-light-installation.h1: Christmas Light Installation in Novi, MI
christmas-light-installation.hero_sub: Clean rooflines, wrapped trees and glowing shrubs for Novi homes, designed to fit your neighborhood's rules and taken down once the holidays are over.
christmas-light-installation.local_paragraph: Most of Novi's farmland and open space has been developed over the decades, so many homes here are suburban houses with long eaves, garage gables and front-yard trees. Those shapes make a clean Christmas display straightforward to plan: a continuous roofline, a few wrapped trees and lit shrubs along the walk. On Walled Lake, the city's largest lake, the display can carry around to the lake-facing side of the house too. We plan every layout, install with bucket-truck crews, keep it glowing through December and remove every strand after the holidays.
considerations: Some homes look best with just a clean roofline. Others add wrapped trees, shrub lighting and a glowing entry. We suggest what will read best from the street, and the estimate lists each element so you can add or drop pieces before anything is scheduled.

In newer neighborhoods, landscaping may still be filling in. Wrapping two or three smaller trees and lighting the shrubs along the front walk gives a young yard real presence, and the plan can grow along with the trees from one season to the next.

If you would like your home glowing by Novi's Light the Lights celebration on Friday, November 20, 2026, request your estimate in early fall. Installation season runs from about October into early December, and those who ask first get the pick of the calendar.
faq: Which parts of Novi do you cover?

All of it. Novi is in Oakland County, one of the three counties our Southeast Michigan service area centers on, so subdivision homes, houses on Walled Lake and larger lots are all on the table. The design starts from your address and a look at the house, not from a template.
Can you work within my HOA's lighting rules?

Yes. Tell us what your association allows, such as colors, placement or install and removal windows, and we will design within those limits. We can provide the design so you can submit it for approval before installation is scheduled.
What is included in a Christmas light estimate?

Each estimate is free and specific to your home. It shows the design and the rooflines, trees and shrubs to be lit, along with how installation, mid-season service and removal will work. If something is not part of the scope, the estimate says so plainly.

commercial-holiday-lighting.title: Commercial Holiday Lighting in Novi, MI
commercial-holiday-lighting.meta_description: Novi commercial holiday lighting for retail centers, Haggerty and Grand River dealerships, offices and HOA entrances. Full-season service, free estimate.
commercial-holiday-lighting.h1: Commercial Holiday Lighting in Novi, MI
commercial-holiday-lighting.hero_sub: Displays built to be seen from busy roads and big parking lots, for retailers, dealerships, offices, property managers and HOAs across Novi.
commercial-holiday-lighting.local_paragraph: Novi's commercial map is easy to read. Retail concentrates around the Novi Road and I-96 interchange, anchored by a regional mall, and car dealerships line Haggerty Road and Grand River Avenue. Customers usually meet those properties through a windshield, often after dark in December, so commercial lighting here has to read at speed: strong building outlines, wrapped trees along the frontage and lit poles that pull the eye toward the entrance. With I-96, I-696, I-275 and M-5 all reaching the city, plenty of drivers pass by each evening. We design, install with bucket trucks, service and remove each display.
considerations: Dealership lots along Haggerty Road and Grand River Avenue tend to be wide and open. Pole and lamppost decor, wrapped trees and a lit building outline give that frontage a clear shape at night without getting in the way of the inventory on the lot.

Shopping centers near the Novi Road interchange compete with every other lit sign in sight. Instead of adding more, we keep the palette tight and the lines clean, so the center reads as one place from the road. The estimate breaks out each building, tree and pole.

If you manage more than one property in and around Novi, a single plan can cover them all. Each site gets its own layout on the estimate, and our crews handle installation, in-season service and takedown, so your maintenance team stays off ladders.
faq: Will you light a car dealership or retail center in Novi?

Yes. Dealerships, shopping centers, offices and other businesses are all part of our commercial work, and Novi is in our Southeast Michigan service area. Describe the frontage, the buildings and any lot restrictions, and the free estimate will be built around them.
Can you install before the holiday shopping rush?

Earlier requests have the most date options. Commercial displays usually go up from October into early December, so reaching out as early in the fall as you can gives the widest choice. Share your store hours, and the install can be scheduled around them where possible.
Is takedown part of the estimate?

Yes. Removal after the holidays comes standard with our full service, the same as design, installation and upkeep during the season. Your estimate lists everything included for the property, so nobody is left guessing about what happens once the season ends.

permanent-lighting.title: Permanent Christmas Lights in Novi, MI
permanent-lighting.meta_description: Permanent Christmas lights for Novi homes: install the roofline once and run it from an app, from December color to a warm everyday glow. Free estimate.
permanent-lighting.hero_sub: Permanent roofline lighting for Novi subdivision homes and Walled Lake houses, planned around your eaves and ready from an app on any night of the year.
permanent-lighting.local_paragraph: Much of Novi's housing went up as farmland gave way to subdivisions, and many of those homes have the long, continuous eaves and clean garage gables that suit permanent lighting well. Once the lights are mounted, there is nothing to hang each fall and nothing to pull down in winter. Everything runs from an app, from a soft white on a weeknight to full color for the holidays. On Walled Lake, a lit lakeside roofline adds to summer nights for anyone out on the water, and the layout can include the lake side as well as the street.
considerations: Because permanent lighting stays up all year, some associations treat it as an exterior change that needs review. Ask your HOA about its process early, since boards may meet only once a month and approval may need to come before an install date is set.

Long, uninterrupted eaves are the easiest rooflines to light permanently. Dormers, hips and multiple gables take more planning, and the estimate shows which lines are included so you know the finished outline before any work begins.

Permanent lighting earns most of its keep on ordinary nights. A soft warm white along the eaves makes the house look welcoming when you pull into the driveway after dark in winter, and the same lights take on holiday color in December with a few taps in the app.
faq: Can you put permanent lights on a Novi subdivision home or a Walled Lake house?

Yes to both. Novi sits inside our service area, and a Walled Lake house can have its lake-facing roofline planned in along with the street side. The free estimate looks at the roofline, notes where power is available and spells out what is included.
Will my HOA allow permanent roofline lighting?

That depends on your association. Some review exterior changes that stay up year-round, so check your HOA's guidelines before install. We can provide the design for submission, which gives the board a clear picture of the finished roofline.
Can I get a traditional Christmas look from permanent lights?
Yes. You can choose a warm white or a traditional multicolor look for December, then switch to game-day colors or a soft accent for the rest of the year. Every setting lives in an app on your phone.
